Fixed the gate failure.

The issue was stale property-test constructors still using the old `NamedSourceDealsDamage { source_name, amount, recipients }` shape after the refactor changed it to `NamedSourceDealsDamage { event: DamageEvent { ... } }`.

I updated:
- `crates/mtg-grammar/tests/prop.rs`
- `crates/mtg-semantic/tests/prop.rs`
- `crates/mtg-grammar/src/lib.rs` to re-export `DamageEvent`, since the public `Statement` variant now exposes it.

Verification passed:
- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test`

No new pest rule was added.
